name: Composer (prompt input)
summary: The single most-used control in an AI product: a form with a growing textarea, attachments, tools, mode/model selection and a send/stop button.

anatomy.description: container (rounded, raised, pinned bottom or centered on empty state)
attachment header with previews and remove
auto-resizing textarea (1 to ~8 lines, then scroll)
footer toolbar: attach, screenshot, slash/actions menu, mode selector, model selector
send button that becomes stop while generating

interactions: Enter submits, Shift+Enter newline (configurable to Cmd/Ctrl+Enter)

accessibility.notes: Real textarea with accessible name; toolbar buttons are labelled buttons with tooltips; Stop reachable within one Tab of the textarea; attachment add/remove announced via role=status; documented keyboard shortcuts.

use_when: inline 'ask' panels in augmented products (compact variant)
avoid_when: a single-line search or command palette is the right mental model (use the NL command bar instead)
exemplars: ChatGPT — pill composer with + menu, tools and dictation
Gemini — Deep Think toggle inside the prompt bar (Feb 2026)
AI Elements PromptInput — status-driven submit/stop button

resolved.title: No literal values
resolved.statement: Component styles read token roles only, through the binding's custom properties; no literal colours, radii, shadows, durations or z-indexes (`#7c3aed`, `oklch(…)`, `border-radius: 12px`, `z-index: 50`, `300ms`).
resolved.rationale: Tokens are the primer; the component is the finish. A literal value breaks every theme at once.

detect.static: A declaration on a component part sets colour, radius, shadow, duration or z-index to anything other than `var(--lq-…)` (or a utility class that does not resolve to a role through the binding).

resolved.fix: Replace with the role's custom property from the binding (see spec/bindings/html.yaml).

resolved.title: Parts are addressable
resolved.statement: Every anatomy part renders with `data-slot="<part>"` so docs, tests and the grader can target it without classes.

detect.static: For each anatomy part marked required, an element with that data-slot exists.

resolved.fix: Add data-slot to the part's root element.
